facts.text: It was a temperate and verdant world, with a comfortable climate despite its challenging ecosystem and dangerous predators.

evidence.quote: It was a temperate and verdant world, with a comfortable climate despite its challenging ecosystem and dangerous predators.

facts.text: Covered in grassy plains where large seed pods grew, it was the homeworld of the Amanin and was inhabited by mastiff phalones.

evidence.quote: Covered in grassy plains where large seed pods grew, it was the homeworld of the Amanin and was inhabited by mastiff phalones.

facts.text: A world of gently undulating terrain covered in rolling grasslands, Maridun survived largely unscathed throughout galactic history due to what little it had to provide offworld industry.

evidence.quote: A world of gently undulating terrain covered in rolling grasslands, Maridun survived largely unscathed throughout galactic history due to what little it had to provide offworld industry.

facts.text: In contrast to other planets like Lothal, Maridun had no resources worth mining from the surface, and instead, had seemingly endless quantities of grass.

evidence.quote: In contrast to other planets like Lothal, Maridun had no resources worth mining from the surface, and instead, had seemingly endless quantities of grass.

facts.text: Maridun maintained a breathable atmosphere as well as a temperate climate, despite its challenging ecosystem and dangerous predators.

evidence.quote: Maridun maintained a breathable atmosphere as well as a temperate climate, despite its challenging ecosystem and dangerous predators.

facts.text: On the surface, the grasses of Maridun grew high, to the point where they could tower over two meters tall.

evidence.quote: On the surface, the grasses of Maridun grew high, to the point where they could tower over two meters tall.

facts.text: The planet's grasslands were interspersed with enormous trees, in areas where water reserves were closest to the surface.

evidence.quote: The planet's grasslands were interspersed with enormous trees, in areas where water reserves were closest to the surface.

facts.text: Thick and deep-rooted, each tree was up of others that grew close by and merged with the main tree over time.

evidence.quote: Thick and deep-rooted, each tree was up of others that grew close by and merged with the main tree over time.

facts.text: During the war, Republic survivors of the Battle of Quell crash-landed there and discovered the Lurmen village.

evidence.quote: During the war, Republic survivors of the Battle of Quell crash-landed there and discovered the Lurmen village.

facts.text: Soon, Separatist General Lok Durd arrived and sought an alliance with the Lurmen, while plotting to test a new weapon known as the Defoliator on them.

evidence.quote: Soon, Separatist General Lok Durd arrived and sought an alliance with the Lurmen, while plotting to test a new weapon known as the Defoliator on them.

facts.text: The Jedi present discovered this and defended the Lurmen village when Durd betrayed them.

evidence.quote: The Jedi present discovered this and defended the Lurmen village when Durd betrayed them.

facts.text: The planet came to support a colony of Lurmen who sought to escape the Clone Wars, and was the site of a battle when Confederate General Lok Durd arrived on the planet to test an experimental weapon.

evidence.quote: The planet came to support a colony of Lurmen who sought to escape the Clone Wars, and was the site of a battle when Confederate General Lok Durd arrived on the planet to test an experimental weapon.

facts.text: The planet was officially discovered by the Galactic Empire around 11 BBY after the Amanin made contact with them.

evidence.quote: The planet was officially discovered by the Galactic Empire around 11 BBY after the Amanin made contact with them.

facts.text: The Empire created several mining colonies on the planet.

evidence.quote: The Empire created several mining colonies on the planet.

facts.text: When the Empire reduced its presence following the Battle of Maridun, the Hutts moved in and enslaved much of the planet.

evidence.quote: When the Empire reduced its presence following the Battle of Maridun, the Hutts moved in and enslaved much of the planet.

facts.text: A temperate world of rolling, grassy plains and forested meadows, the planet Maridun remained largely devoid of permanent settlements until the rise of the Galactic Empire.

evidence.quote: A temperate world of rolling, grassy plains and forested meadows, the planet Maridun remained largely devoid of permanent settlements until the rise of the Galactic Empire.

facts.text: Wildlife native to Maridun included birds, herd animals, dangerous predatory animals called charnoqs, mastiff phalones, carrier butterflies, fwits, and enormous lumbering corinathoths.

evidence.quote: Wildlife native to Maridun included birds, herd animals, dangerous predatory animals called charnoqs, mastiff phalones, carrier butterflies, fwits, and enormous lumbering corinathoths.

facts.text: Maridun was a subject world of the Infinite Empire, though any and all traces of that long-forgotten government had disappeared by the time explorers first came upon the planet during the millennium surrounding the blazing of the Hydian Way.

evidence.quote: Maridun was a subject world of the Infinite Empire, though any and all traces of that long-forgotten government had disappeared by the time explorers first came upon the planet during the millennium surrounding the blazing of the Hydian Way.

facts.text: Those who first visited the planet quickly found the native Amanin to be frightening and vicious, and no known colonies were established during the time before the Ruusan Reformation of the Galactic Republic.

evidence.quote: Those who first visited the planet quickly found the native Amanin to be frightening and vicious, and no known colonies were established during the time before the Ruusan Reformation of the Galactic Republic.

facts.text: While not directly involved in any early conflicts with the Republic, Maridun was located in space controlled by the Mandalorians during the Mandalorian Wars and later the Sith Empire during the Jedi Civil War.

evidence.quote: While not directly involved in any early conflicts with the Republic, Maridun was located in space controlled by the Mandalorians during the Mandalorian Wars and later the Sith Empire during the Jedi Civil War.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars, a conflict between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the Republic, a colony of Lurmen was established on the planet.

evidence.quote: During the Clone Wars, a conflict between the Confederacy of Independent Systems and the Republic, a colony of Lurmen was established on the planet.

facts.text: As the Lurmen were pacifists, Maridun's neutrality and independence offered them a haven from the war, which had quickly spread to their species' homeworld of Mygeeto, a Republic target because of its affiliation with the InterGalactic Banking Clan.

evidence.quote: As the Lurmen were pacifists, Maridun's neutrality and independence offered them a haven from the war, which had quickly spread to their species' homeworld of Mygeeto, a Republic target because of its affiliation with the InterGalactic Banking Clan.

facts.text: Led by village elder Tee Watt Kaa, the Lurmen erected a strongly pacifist society; nevertheless, the war was brought to them when a Republic cruiser carrying members of the Jedi Order crash-landed on the planet after a hyperdrive malfunction.

evidence.quote: Led by village elder Tee Watt Kaa, the Lurmen erected a strongly pacifist society; nevertheless, the war was brought to them when a Republic cruiser carrying members of the Jedi Order crash-landed on the planet after a hyperdrive malfunction.

facts.text: In hopes of aiding an injured Jedi Knight named Anakin Skywalker, Padawan Ahsoka Tano and Jedi Knight Aayla Secura sought out the Lurmen settlement.

evidence.quote: In hopes of aiding an injured Jedi Knight named Anakin Skywalker, Padawan Ahsoka Tano and Jedi Knight Aayla Secura sought out the Lurmen settlement.

facts.text: As the Jedi began the recovery process, Confederate General Lok Durd landed on the planet and claimed to represent a peaceful government interested in saving the Lurmen from the Jedi Order and the Republic.

evidence.quote: As the Jedi began the recovery process, Confederate General Lok Durd landed on the planet and claimed to represent a peaceful government interested in saving the Lurmen from the Jedi Order and the Republic.

facts.text: Maridun was, in fact, a prime location to test fire the Defoliator weapon the Confederacy had just constructed.

evidence.quote: Maridun was, in fact, a prime location to test fire the Defoliator weapon the Confederacy had just constructed.

facts.text: Kaa nearly accepted the Lurmen "destiny" to be destroyed by this weapon, but the recovered Jedi went against his orders to leave the planet and set up a shield defense around the village.

evidence.quote: Kaa nearly accepted the Lurmen "destiny" to be destroyed by this weapon, but the recovered Jedi went against his orders to leave the planet and set up a shield defense around the village.

facts.text: During the ensuing battle, the Jedi disabled the Defoliator and captured Durd.

evidence.quote: During the ensuing battle, the Jedi disabled the Defoliator and captured Durd.

facts.text: Years after the war, using old data files on the planet, the Empire officially annexed the world in 11 BBY and established a mining operation on the planet.

evidence.quote: Years after the war, using old data files on the planet, the Empire officially annexed the world in 11 BBY and established a mining operation on the planet.

facts.text: While the Imperial occupation went unperturbed for its first decade, the tribal Amanin rose up in defiance of the Imperial invaders and attacked the colony.

evidence.quote: While the Imperial occupation went unperturbed for its first decade, the tribal Amanin rose up in defiance of the Imperial invaders and attacked the colony.

facts.text: As the casualties mounted, Imperial officer Janek Sunber, who had taken the command of the Imperial forces following the death of General Ziering, discovered the Amanin concept of takital and that they were an intelligent species capable of negotiating.

evidence.quote: As the casualties mounted, Imperial officer Janek Sunber, who had taken the command of the Imperial forces following the death of General Ziering, discovered the Amanin concept of takital and that they were an intelligent species capable of negotiating.

facts.text: Following a bloody battle, the Imperials made a deal with an Amanin lorekeeper in which his tribe would help slave traders capture Amanin from other tribes as slaves.

evidence.quote: Following a bloody battle, the Imperials made a deal with an Amanin lorekeeper in which his tribe would help slave traders capture Amanin from other tribes as slaves.

facts.text: Following the Imperial victory on Maridun, the battle became something of a legend amongst Imperial infantry, the Imperial propaganda machine having made the battle into a heroic struggle for survival—and of course, a success—from the display of officer ineptitude it had in fact been.

evidence.quote: Following the Imperial victory on Maridun, the battle became something of a legend amongst Imperial infantry, the Imperial propaganda machine having made the battle into a heroic struggle for survival—and of course, a success—from the display of officer ineptitude it had in fact been.

facts.text: After the Empire moved its attention towards other systems, smaller private interests, especially those associated with criminals like the Hutts, began to take control of the slave trade.

evidence.quote: After the Empire moved its attention towards other systems, smaller private interests, especially those associated with criminals like the Hutts, began to take control of the slave trade.

facts.text: After only a few years of Imperial and private slave trading, Amanin were spread through much of the galaxy.

evidence.quote: After only a few years of Imperial and private slave trading, Amanin were spread through much of the galaxy.

facts.text: Some of these Amanin returned to Maridun with blasters and other advanced technology, taking control of local tribes.

evidence.quote: Some of these Amanin returned to Maridun with blasters and other advanced technology, taking control of local tribes.

facts.text: As cities began forming around old Imperial spaceports, the planet quickly became a hideout for those hoping to avoid local law enforcement in neighboring star systems.

evidence.quote: As cities began forming around old Imperial spaceports, the planet quickly became a hideout for those hoping to avoid local law enforcement in neighboring star systems.

facts.text: Following the fall of the Empire, Maridun was located in space controlled by Zsinj's Empire.

evidence.quote: Following the fall of the Empire, Maridun was located in space controlled by Zsinj's Empire.

facts.text: When the Yuuzhan Vong invaded the galaxy, Maridun was cut off from the rest of civilization and controlled by the Yuuzhan Vong empire from 27 to 29 ABY until the Yuuzhan Vong were defeated and driven from the worlds they had conquered.

evidence.quote: When the Yuuzhan Vong invaded the galaxy, Maridun was cut off from the rest of civilization and controlled by the Yuuzhan Vong empire from 27 to 29 ABY until the Yuuzhan Vong were defeated and driven from the worlds they had conquered.

facts.text: A Separatist outpost was a CIS mobile command center on the planet Maridun was used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars for weapons testing.

evidence.quote: A Separatist outpost was a CIS mobile command center on the planet Maridun was used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars for weapons testing.

facts.text: The Battle of Maridun was a localized conflict between the Imperial forces stationed on Maridun and the local Amanin inhabitants.

evidence.quote: The Battle of Maridun was a localized conflict between the Imperial forces stationed on Maridun and the local Amanin inhabitants.

facts.text: A battle at the planet Maridun was fought between the forces of the New Republic under Admiral Gial Ackbar and Warlord Treuten Teradoc's Greater Maldrood at Maridun in 8.5 ABY.

evidence.quote: A battle at the planet Maridun was fought between the forces of the New Republic under Admiral Gial Ackbar and Warlord Treuten Teradoc's Greater Maldrood at Maridun in 8.5 ABY.

facts.text: The Defense of Maridun, also known as the Battle of Maridun, took place in 22 BBY on the planet of Maridun during the Clone Wars.

evidence.quote: The Defense of Maridun, also known as the Battle of Maridun, took place in 22 BBY on the planet of Maridun during the Clone Wars.

facts.text: In 21 BBY during the Clone Wars, a Lurmen village on Maridun was defended from Separatist forces by a group of stranded Jedi and Galactic Republic soldiers.

evidence.quote: In 21 BBY during the Clone Wars, a Lurmen village on Maridun was defended from Separatist forces by a group of stranded Jedi and Galactic Republic soldiers.

facts.outcome: Galactic Republic/Lurmen victory, Lok Durd captured and taken into custody

facts.text: During the Clone Wars, this skirmish took place on planet Maridun between a local tribe of Amanin and a group of Lurmen refugees from the planet Mygeeto.
